en: Grunt
Yo yo yo! Look who's wandered onto our pier. A little island challenger, huh?
Team Skull says this pier's ours today. Wanna argue? Then let's battle!
Grunt
Tch! You got lucky. Come on, let's split. This place is boring anyway.
Ilima
Well handled! I was about to step in, but you didn't need me at all. I'm Ilima, a trial captain of this island.
A trial-goer who battles like that... Let me see it for myself. Your Pokémon are tired, so allow me.
Ilima
Splendid! You and your partner understand each other well.
My trial waits in Verdant Cavern, up Route 2. But first you need the kahuna's blessing: the festival in Iki Town is tonight, and Hala will be expecting you.
Grunt
What're you looking at?
Ilima
Verdant Cavern is north up Route 2. I'll be waiting.
Prof. Kukui
Woo! There's the island's newest grand trial winner! Hala told me all about it, cousin.
Melemele's done, so Akala's next. My boat's tied up right here. Hop in and I'll take you across!
The professor's boat skimmed out of the marina and across the bright sea to Akala Island...
Prof. Kukui
Welcome to Akala! Heahea City's just up the beach. The nearest trial is north, past Route 4 and Paniola Town. Have fun out there!
Prof. Kukui
Whenever you're ready, step onto the pier and we'll set sail for Akala.
Sailor
This ferry crosses to Akala Island. It's for trial-goers who've finished Melemele's grand trial, so come back once the kahuna's seen what you can do!
All aboard for Akala Island! Shall we sail?
The ferry pulled out of Hau'oli Marina...
